message.content:
Build the Pricing page and Custom Plan CTA component for the Boldteq marketing site.

**Project:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq`
**Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, CSS Modules

**IMPORTANT:** Read CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md first. This project uses Next.js 16.2.3 — read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` for any breaking changes before writing code. Never use `any` type.

**Create these files:**

### 1. `src/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta.tsx` + `src/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta.module.css`

A blue section CTA that says "Need Something More Flexible?" with benefits and a button.

Content:
- Title: "Need Something More Flexible?"
- Subtitle: "Create a custom subscription based on your workload, turnaround needs, and workflow."
- 4 benefits with checkmark icons: "Flexible capacity", "Custom turnaround", "Multiple projects or brands", "Simple monthly pricing"
- CTA button: "Build Your Custom Plan" → links to /contact
- Background: Navy (#082753)
- Use the existing check icon at `/images/webflow/Group-1.svg`

Style it with CSS Modules. Navy background, white text, gradient cyan button. The benefits should be in a horizontal flex row that wraps on mobile.

### 2. `src/app/pricing/page.tsx`

The pricing page route. This is a SERVER component.

Structure:
```tsx
import { createMetadata } from "@/lib/seo/metadata";
import { PricingSection } from "@/components/home/pricing-section";
import { CustomPlanCta } from "@/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta";
import { RoiCalculator } from "@/components/pricing/roi-calculator";
import { BetaCta } from "@/components/shared/beta-cta";

export const metadata = createMetadata({
  title: "White Label Web Development Pricing | Plans from $999/mo | Boldteq",
  description: "Transparent white-label web dev pricing for agencies. Starter $999/mo, Growth $1,999/mo, Pro $3,499/mo. No contracts, pause anytime. 14-day guarantee.",
  path: "/pricing",
});

export default function PricingPage() {
  return (
    <>
      <PricingSection />
      <CustomPlanCta />
      <RoiCalculator />
      <BetaCta />
    </>
  );
}
```

The page reuses the existing `PricingSection` component from the homepage (which already has the pricing cards + billing toggle + comparison table). Then adds the custom plan CTA, ROI calculator, and beta CTA.

**Key patterns to follow:**
- Read `src/app/page.tsx` for how the homepage composes sections
- Read `src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx` for CTA pattern
- Read `src/components/shared/beta-cta.tsx` for the beta CTA
- Read `src/lib/seo/metadata.ts` for the metadata factory
- The page is a server component — no "use client"
- Export `metadata` const at the top level

Also add JSON-LD structured data for the pricing page as a `<script>` tag. The schema should be:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Service",
  "serviceType": "White Label Web Development",
  "provider": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Boldteq"},
  "hasOfferCatalog": {
    "@type": "OfferCatalog",
    "itemListElement": [
      {"@type":"Offer","name":"Starter","price":"999","priceCurrency":"USD"},
      {"@type":"Offer","name":"Growth","price":"1999","priceCurrency":"USD"},
      {"@type":"Offer","name":"Pro","price":"3499","priceCurrency":"USD"}
    ]
  }
}
```

Use `<script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(schema) }} />` inside a fragment.

**`src/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta.tsx`**

**`src/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta.module.css`**
Benefits flex-wrap row on desktop, stacks to column on mobile (`<480px`). Gradient button matches `skyButton` pattern from `beta-cta.module.css`.

**`src/components/pricing/roi-calculator.tsx`** + **`roi-calculator.module.css`**
Interactive client component. Hourly rate toggle (6 options) + plan selector (Starter/Growth/Pro). Computes freelancer equivalent cost, savings amount, savings %, and effective hourly rate in real time via `useMemo`. No `any` types.

**`src/app/pricing/page.tsx`**
Server component. Exports `metadata` via `createMetadata`. Composes `PricingSection` → `CustomPlanCta` → `RoiCalculator` → `BetaCta`. Injects Service schema JSON-LD as a `<script>` tag before the first section.
